title: Interpretive Justice / Relational Subjecthood
purpose: Define how Potatoist relational philosophy handles interpretation of persons, groups and other subjects without allowing either outside classification or first-person self-description to become total and self-sealing.
boundary: Interpretive Justice disciplines judgment; it does not abolish judgment. Subjects remain criticizable, evidence remains testable, and domain-appropriate external facts may outweigh self-report on questions outside first-person meaning.
historical_boundary: The named eleven-law family is a September 16, 2026 archive crystallization unless an earlier direct source is separately recovered. Several underlying principles predate the crystallization and are traced in the source map.

irreducible_subjecthood.title: Law of Irreducible Subjecthood
irreducible_subjecthood.principle: A subject is not identical to any single representation of the subject.
irreducible_subjecthood.corruption: Diagnosis, accusation, conviction, reputation, persona, meme, dossier, role or archive record becomes total biography.
irreducible_subjecthood.test: What relevant dimensions disappear when this description is treated as the whole subject?

situated_first_person_authority.title: Law of Situated First-Person Authority
situated_first_person_authority.principle: A person is a primary source for intended meaning, self-description, remembered experience and internally held identity.
situated_first_person_authority.boundary: Self-description is primary evidence for first-person meaning but does not automatically settle external empirical fact, hidden motive, consequence, law, medicine, history or another person's experience.
situated_first_person_authority.corruption: Either outsiders erase the available first-person account, or self-report is treated as proof of every external proposition.
situated_first_person_authority.test: Which part of this claim concerns first-person meaning, and which part reaches into independently testable reality?

recognition_without_ownership.title: Law of Recognition Without Ownership
recognition_without_ownership.principle: Observation, classification, diagnosis, criticism or recognition does not grant ownership or authorship of the observed subject.
recognition_without_ownership.corruption: The classifier treats its representation as more real than the subject it describes.
recognition_without_ownership.test: Can the subject remain more than the classifier's schema?

bounded_jurisdiction.title: Law of Bounded Jurisdiction
bounded_jurisdiction.principle: Every interpretive frame has a legitimate scope, and its authority weakens when exported beyond the domain that gives it competence.
bounded_jurisdiction.formula: useful local frame -> successful explanation -> export beyond domain -> jurisdiction creep -> totalization
bounded_jurisdiction.corruption: A medical, legal, theological, archival, political or audience frame becomes a whole-person ontology.
bounded_jurisdiction.test: What authority does this interpreter actually possess over this specific question?

hearing_before_totalization.title: Law of Hearing Before Totalization
hearing_before_totalization.principle: Strong characterization should follow serious hearing rather than replace it.
hearing_before_totalization.corruption: The category is decided first and every reply is interpreted as further proof.
hearing_before_totalization.test: What evidence, reply or changed circumstance could make this interpretation revise itself?

evidentiary_proportionality.title: Law of Evidentiary Proportionality
evidentiary_proportionality.principle: The greater a characterization's severity, reach, persistence and identity-impact, the greater its source and correction burdens should be.
evidentiary_proportionality.formula: required evidence increases with severity × reach × persistence × identity-impact
evidentiary_proportionality.boundary: This is an archive/philosophy heuristic, not a replacement for jurisdiction-specific legal burdens of proof.
evidentiary_proportionality.test: Is the evidentiary quality proportionate to what the characterization can do to the subject?

independent_witness.title: Law of Independent Witness
independent_witness.principle: Repetition changes distribution but does not automatically create independent corroboration.
independent_witness.formula: N copies of source A != N independent sources
independent_witness.corruption: Derivative summaries recursively cite or imitate one origin until repetition looks like consensus.
independent_witness.test: How many genuinely independent provenance roots support the claim?

reply_and_correctability.title: Law of Reply and Correctability
reply_and_correctability.principle: A system that can durably describe a subject but cannot meaningfully receive relevant correction is epistemically one-way.
reply_and_correctability.healthy: claim -> source -> reply -> comparison -> correction/update -> preserved provenance
reply_and_correctability.shadow: claim -> label -> archive -> repetition -> reply ignored -> apparent consensus
reply_and_correctability.test: Can materially relevant correction change the durable record?

contextual_reaction.title: Law of Contextual Reaction
contextual_reaction.principle: A reaction is evidence that the reaction occurred; by itself it does not establish the interpretation imposed upon that reaction.
contextual_reaction.sequence: prior condition -> interaction/input -> reaction -> interpretation -> consequence
contextual_reaction.corruption: The response is detached from precipitating conditions and converted into timeless identity.
contextual_reaction.test: Would the interpretation remain persuasive if the preceding sequence were displayed beside the reaction?

proportional_memory.title: Law of Proportional Memory
proportional_memory.principle: Memory should preserve history together with correction, changed status and development rather than turning old information into permanent identity captivity.
proportional_memory.formula: memory + update + context -> learning; memory without update -> identity lock
proportional_memory.corruption: Accusation remains searchable and durable while correction or development disappears.
proportional_memory.test: Does the archive remember correction and changed status as durably as the original claim?

non_retaliatory_correction.title: Law of Non-Retaliatory Correction
non_retaliatory_correction.principle: Being harmed does not require reproducing the harmful method in reverse.
non_retaliatory_correction.formula: harm -> recognition -> boundary/correction/repair, not harm -> mirrored degradation -> reproduced ecology
non_retaliatory_correction.corruption: A critique of dehumanization becomes dehumanization of a new target.
non_retaliatory_correction.test: Does the corrective method dismantle the mechanism or merely exchange who occupies its target position?

no_win_frame.title: Law of Non-Self-Sealing Response
no_win_frame.principle: An interpretive system must permit at least some possible reply, evidence or changed condition to alter the classification.
no_win_frame.corruption: Opposite responses are all interpreted as proof of the same conclusion.
no_win_frame.test: What response or evidence would genuinely count against this frame?

status_proportionality.title: Law of Status Proportionality
status_proportionality.principle: The more an interpretation can damage credibility, belonging, employability, safety or future access, the stronger its evidentiary, correction and expiry obligations become.
status_proportionality.boundary: This is an ethical/archive burden, not a substitute for legal defamation standards.
status_proportionality.test: Is the persistence and reach of the characterization proportionate to the quality and currentness of the evidence?

reentry_and_role_expiry.title: Law of Re-entry and Role Expiry
reentry_and_role_expiry.principle: A durable social judgment should identify whether and how a person can move into a different current state.
reentry_and_role_expiry.corruption: The archive permits accusation but no recognized route to changed status.
reentry_and_role_expiry.test: What event, repair, evidence or period of changed conduct would retire this role?

authorship_recovery.title: Law of Recovered Authorship
authorship_recovery.principle: A subject should retain meaningful ability to contribute to the durable story of their own life without receiving unilateral control over external facts.
authorship_recovery.corruption: Outside archives become exclusive authors of identity, or self-description is treated as infallible.
authorship_recovery.test: Can the subject's later development, correction and current self-understanding become discoverable beside the inherited frame?

enemy_independence.title: Law of Enemy Independence
enemy_independence.principle: A community should be able to sustain identity, purpose and cohesion without requiring a permanent condemned target.
enemy_independence.corruption: Shared opposition becomes so central that target decay threatens the group's own identity and a substitute target is required.
enemy_independence.test: What positive object, practice or purpose remains if the enemy disappears?

derived_concepts.representation_gap: Distance between a subject's direct account and a dominant circulating representation; a reason to investigate, not a verdict about which account is correct.
derived_concepts.identity_compression: multidimensional subject -> salient attribute/event -> totalizing identity
derived_concepts.narrative_lock_in: label -> selective attention -> label-confirming interpretation -> reaction -> archive -> inherited expectation
derived_concepts.tribunalization: Durable classification and reputational punishment power without equivalent hearing, evidence, reply, correction and review obligations.
derived_concepts.jurisdiction_creep: A useful local frame exported until it claims the whole subject.
derived_concepts.falsifier_loss: The point at which no possible reply, evidence or changed condition is allowed to revise the interpretation.
derived_concepts.classification_asymmetry: Unequal power between classifier and classified to define the durable public representation.
derived_concepts.correction_asymmetry: Unequal reach, persistence or rediscovery between an original claim and its correction.
derived_concepts.no_win_frame: Any response is absorbed as confirmation; operationally equivalent to falsifier loss at the interaction level.
derived_concepts.status_capture: A circulating representation alters the subject's social starting position before direct encounter.
derived_concepts.social_exile: Exclusion or association-cost that reduces belonging/access and can persist through archived stigma.
derived_concepts.authorship_recovery: Restoration of enough narrative agency that external archives no longer have exclusive authorship over current public identity.
derived_concepts.enemy_dependence: Group cohesion or role prestige becomes structurally dependent on a recurring opponent/target.
derived_concepts.reentry_failure: A system recognizes accusation/exile but has no recognized mechanism for changed current status.

potato_mapping.Door: permit reply, correction and state change
potato_mapping.House: preserve differentiated persons and rooms without collapse
potato_mapping.Spiral: allow memory to update after return
potato_mapping.Garden: leave subjects and readers with greater future agency rather than permanent informational dependency

anti_self_sealing: A doctrine that cannot name what would change its conclusion has lost its falsifier.
